name: Pigment orange 36
description: Pigment Orange 36 (CAS 12236-62-3 ), also known as Permanent Orange HL and PV Orange HL, is a high-performance organic azo pigment delivering a clean, reddish-orange hue. It offers strong heat stability and lightfastness. These properties make it a preferred colorant choice across demanding industrial applications where color durability under processing conditions is a procurement priority. In plastics and polymers, it is used to color engineering resins. It is ideal for polyolefins that undergo high-temperature processing, where its thermal resistance helps maintain shade integrity. Coatings formulators incorporate it into industrial and decorative finishes requiring outdoor durability. It provides excellent resistance to color fade in various environments. In printing and packaging, it is specified for high-quality flexographic and offset inks where clean tone and print sharpness are critical to brand consistency. Textile, leather, and paper applications use it in surface coatings and pigment printing pastes. It is favored where a vivid orange with good wash and rub fastness is required for long-lasting consumer goods. The product is supplied as a dry powder, typically in press cake or flushed paste form depending on the end-use processing method. Standard commercial grades are available in conventional and transparent variants. Particle size and surface treatment are adjusted for specific dispersion requirements.
